name: WindTrail
description: A smooth curved ribbon streams behind the pointer, widest where you were moving fastest and narrowing along its length toward the older end. It appears once the pointer passes the activation speed and fades away again as the pointer comes to rest. A fast flick leaves a long thick streak and a slow drag leaves a thin one. The path is smoothed before it is drawn, so an unsteady hand still gets a clean curve.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Thickness
parameters.description: Width of the ribbon at full speed (px)

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description: How long a point on the path stays lit at full speed (seconds)

parameters.name: Activation speed
parameters.description: Pointer speed the ribbon starts appearing at (px per second)

parameters.name: Smoothing
parameters.description: How much the path is smoothed before it is drawn, 0 to follow it exactly
